870752321de87f92.description:
We are looking for a CRM executive to support the execution and day-to-day operations of customer engagement and retention campaigns across multiple communication channels. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in CRM campaign execution, audience management, campaign QA, journey monitoring, and reporting. The role requires strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously. The candidate will work closely with the retention marketing, martech, data, product, and business teams to ensure accurate, timely, and effective customer communication across two brands.

Key Responsibilities: 

A. CRM campaign execution:
1. Support the end-to-end execution of CRM campaigns across multiple channels, including push notifications, email, WhatsApp, RCS, and in-app messaging
2. Set up campaigns and customer journeys based on campaign briefs and defined requirements
3. Ensure campaigns are launched accurately and within agreed timelines
4. Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously while maintaining execution quality

B. Audience management & validation:
1. Create, upload, validate, and manage campaign audiences and customer segments
2. Cross-check audience criteria against campaign requirements before campaign launch
3. Perform data validation and identify discrepancies in audience counts or customer attributes
4. Coordinate with data and martech teams to resolve audience-related issues

C. Campaign QA & quality control:
1. Conduct thorough pre-launch QA of campaign content, targeting, scheduling, links, personalization, and channel configurations
2. Validate deep links, UTM parameters, tracking tags, and campaign parameters wherever applicable
3. Ensure communication content is correctly configured across different devices and channels
4. Identify and report campaign errors before launch to minimize operational issues

D. Customer journey monitoring:
1. Monitor automated CRM journeys and campaign performance after launch
2. Track journey entry, delivery, engagement, conversion, and drop-off metrics
3. Identify failed journeys, delivery issues, or unexpected customer behavior
4. Escalate technical or platform-related issues to the appropriate teams and ensure timely resolution

E. Campaign reporting & analysis:
1. Prepare regular campaign performance reports and dashboards
2. Track key metrics such as delivery rate, open/click rate, engagement rate, conversion rate, unsubscribe/opt-out rate, campaign revenue, and customer retention
3. Maintain campaign trackers and execution reports
4. Provide basic insights and observations to the Retention Marketing Manager

F. Cross-functional coordination:
1. Coordinate with retention marketing, martech, data analytics, product, creative, and technology teams for campaign execution
2. Understand campaign briefs and translate requirements into accurate campaign setups
3. Follow up on dependencies to ensure campaigns are launched on time
4. Maintain proper documentation of campaign configurations, results, and learnings

G. Campaign operations & process improvement:
1. Support increasing campaign volumes across both brands while maintaining execution quality
2. Maintain campaign calendars, trackers, checklists, and operational documentation
3. Identify repetitive operational tasks and suggest opportunities for process improvement or automation
4. Follow defined CRM processes and quality standards to reduce campaign errors

87d4dc9aa346c450.description: Position Summary: 3i Infotech is seeking a highly skilled, seasoned Informatica ETL Developer with over eight years of experience to join our enterprise data engineering operations in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. In this mission-critical technical role, you will take ownership of designing, building, deploying, and maintaining scalable enterprise ETL and ELT data pipelines that power analytical platforms and business-critical systems. Leveraging at least five years of specialized hands-on expertise in Informatica PowerCenter, you will collaborate with data architects to optimize database performance, enforce strict data load SLAs, and ensure seamless business-as-usual (BAU) operational continuity. This position offers an outstanding platform for an accomplished data integration specialist to deliver high-impact data solutions within a premier global technology services provider. Detailed Job Description: As an Informatica ETL Developer at 3i Infotech in Abu Dhabi, you will hold comprehensive technical responsibility for enterprise data integration workflows, high-throughput batch transformations, and complex data pipeline architectures. Operating at the vital intersection of data modeling and operational data delivery, you will partner closely with Data Modelers, Data Architects, database administrators, and business stakeholders to translate complex business rules into robust, high-performance data warehousing solutions. Your core technical scope encompasses developing and optimizing advanced Informatica PowerCenter mappings, sessions, and workflows, alongside tuning intricate SQL queries to maximize data throughput and minimize latency. You will actively manage data extraction from heterogeneous source systems, implement error handling and audit logging frameworks, and diagnose performance bottlenecks across large-scale relational databases and data repositories. Furthermore, you will take full ownership of production data load SLAs, troubleshoot root causes of job failures, provide Tier-3 BAU operational support, and uphold rigorous data engineering documentation and governance best practices. This role demands sharp diagnostic problem-solving capabilities, proven data warehousing rigor, and a steadfast dedication to high-availability enterprise data delivery. Key Responsibilities: Design, build, test, and maintain scalable, robust enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines utilizing Informatica PowerCenter. Execute complex data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) routines from disparate and heterogeneous source systems into target data warehouses. Collaborate actively with Data Modelers and Data Architects to design and refine high-performance relational and dimensional data models. Optimize and fine-tune complex SQL queries, database indexing, and data staging schemas to maximize retrieval throughput and reduce processing latency. Perform comprehensive root cause analysis (RCA) and troubleshooting for complex pipeline bottlenecks, data discrepancies, and workflow failures. Ensure strict compliance with business data load SLAs and provide proactive Tier-3 support for smooth Business-As-Usual (BAU) data operations. Maintain detailed technical documentation, data mapping specifications, source-to-target dictionaries, and operational runbooks. Enforce and uphold enterprise data governance standards, data engineering best practices, code quality audits, and version control procedures. Required Qualifications & Skills: Minimum 8+ years of total professional IT experience in data integration, data warehousing, and enterprise ETL engineering. Minimum 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on development expertise utilizing Informatica PowerCenter (Designer, Workflow Manager, Workflow Monitor). Extensive hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying complex ETL/ELT pipelines and transformation logic. Strong technical expertise in relational database systems (Oracle, SQL Server, or Teradata) and advanced SQL performance tuning. Proven experience collaborating closely with Data Architects and Data Modelers on Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, and dimensional modeling implementations. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex production workflow failures, optimize bottlenecked mappings, and perform thorough root cause analysis. Documented track record of maintaining and delivering against strict business data load SLAs within high-availability BAU environments. Excellent professional communication, collaboration, and stakeholder coordination skills with fluency in English. Nice-to-Have Skills: Informatica PowerCenter Developer or Administrator certification. Hands-on experience with UNIX/Linux shell scripting to automate batch ETL scheduling and file processing routines. Familiarity with enterprise job scheduling tools such as Control-M, Autosys, or UC4/Automic. Exposure to cloud data warehousing platforms .

A fresh omnichannel CX platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to take end-to-end ownership of the product from co-creation through to market launch, revenue generation, and P&L accountability. - Experience working with marketing/growth agencies for demand generation

- High ownership mentality comfortable operating independently with minimal oversight

- Product launch timeline adherence

- Sales team ramp-up and revenue attainment vs. target

- Product P&L profitability
